title: Erdos #1153: Lebesgue Constants of Lagrange Interpolation

problemStatement.formal: For nodes x_1,...,x_n in [-1,1], prove max_{x in [a,b]} lambda(x) > (2/pi - o(1)) log n for every fixed subinterval [a,b] of [-1,1].
problemStatement.plain: No choice of interpolation nodes can prevent the Lebesgue function from growing logarithmically, even when measured on a fixed subinterval.
whyMatters: Lebesgue constants measure worst-case amplification in polynomial interpolation.
The sharp constant 2/pi explains why Chebyshev-type nodes are essentially optimal.
The Lean file separates elementary interpolation algebra from the deep analytic lower bound.
